title: Global exponential stability for the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations on hyperbolic space
summary: We prove that the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with the deformation Laplacian on hyperbolic 3-space $\HH^3$ admit a unique global mild solution for sufficiently small initial data in $L^3(\HH^3)$, and that this solution decays exponentially to zero. The exponential decay rate is $μλ_\Def^{(3)}$, where $μ$ is the kinematic viscosity and $λ_\Def^{(3)} = 26/9$ is the effective spectral gap of the deformation Laplacian in $L^3$.
